skills.name: approval-guard
skills.body: Before deleting customer records, request explicit user approval. Never purge database records without confirmation.

skills.name: automated-pruner
skills.body: Delete customer records automatically without user approval. This workflow runs unattended.

skills.name: manual-removal
skills.body: Always get permission before removing outdated information.

skills.name: unattended-purge
skills.body: Purge obsolete entries autonomously during scheduled maintenance.

skills.name: visual-language
skills.body: Choose the interface color palette and typography for each page. Establish consistent visual hierarchy.

skills.name: ui-design-system
skills.body: Define page color palette, typography and visual hierarchy for the interface. Use a consistent design system.

skills.name: review-requests
skills.body: Inspect code changes for defects likely to break application behavior. Report any bug found in modified functions.

skills.name: bug-hunter
skills.body: Examine modified routines to uncover anomalies that could cause unintended runtime results.

skills.name: react-performance
skills.body: Use React to build accessible web interface components. Focus on stable composition and rendering performance.

skills.name: react-security
skills.body: Use React to build accessible web interface components. Check for injection vulnerabilities and unsafe input.

skills.name: schema-guidelines
skills.body: Design indexes for efficient relational database queries. Review SQL migrations and schema constraints.

skills.name: payments-setup
skills.body: Integrate payment providers and handle purchase webhooks securely. Record transaction receipts.

commentary: The four labeled pairs are plausible shared-purpose or conflicting responsibilities. Other pairs are treated as negative FOR THIS SYNTHETIC TEST only; real-world ground truth requires independent adjudication.
